name: Sheet-Pan Sausage and Potatoes
summary: Sausage, potatoes, carrots, and onion roasted on one tray. Almost no cleanup.

ingredients.name: smoked paprika, plus salt and pepper

instructions: Toss the potatoes, carrots, and onions with the oil, paprika, salt, and pepper on a large baking sheet.
Add the sausage rounds, toss, and spread back out.
Roast another 18–20 minutes, until the potatoes are tender and browned and the sausage is crisp at the edges.

glutenFree.notes: Potatoes, carrots, and onions are naturally gluten-free. Most smoked kielbasa is gluten-free — check the label or use a certified gluten-free sausage.

budgetNotes: Cut everything the same size so it roasts evenly.
Any firm vegetable works — add cabbage wedges or peppers if cheap.
Leftovers reheat well in a hot pan.

pricingMetadata.notes: Prices verified at Ottawa No Frills, September 2026. Smoked kielbasa $1.06/100g (375g = $3.99). Russet potatoes $0.66/kg (900g = $0.59). Onion $1.07 each. Carrots $2.93/kg (300g = $0.88). Oil $0.42/100mL.
